master_skills.name: core-synergy-skill
master_skills.title_zh: core-synergy-skill (底層協同與工程門禁全集)
master_skills.description_zh: 本技能定義 Antigravity 與 OpenCode 雙 Agent 協同架構、多模型分工策略、領域模型審核機制與自動化二方代碼門禁。
master_skills.description_en: Defines Antigravity & OpenCode dual-agent architecture, multi-model delegation, domain grilling, and automated code review gate.

principles.title_zh: 系統架構：雙 Agent (Antigravity × OpenCode) 與異構模型分工
principles.title_en: Architecture: Dual Agents (Antigravity × OpenCode) & Multi-Model Delegation
principles.desc_zh: Antigravity 作為主要控制節點，負責高階系統架構規劃與 UI/UX 美學基調；OpenCode 作為終端機執行節點，負責背景代碼寫入、型態檢查與單元測試。兩者皆可依任務複雜度動態派發 Gemini 或 Claude 作為獨立 Subagent 處理子任務，並在提交前執行 open-code-review 二方代碼掃描。
principles.desc_en: Antigravity serves as the primary leader node for system planning and UI/UX design. OpenCode acts as the secondary leader for terminal execution and testing. Both dispatch Gemini or Claude subagents, followed by open-code-review scanning.

principles.title_zh: 工作流程：grill-with-docs 領域模型與架構對齊機制
principles.title_en: Workflow: grill-with-docs Domain Modeling & Architecture Alignment
principles.desc_zh: 當輸入包含「架構」、「規劃」、「設計」等意圖關鍵字時，系統自動啟動需求對齊程序。透過結構化問答釐清領域模型 (Domain Modeling) 與系統邊界，確定無誤後生成 `.antigravity/tasks/task-xxx.md` 任務看板檔，再交由 OpenCode 進行非互動式執行與驗證。
principles.desc_en: When keywords like 'architecture' or 'planning' are detected, system initiates domain grilling to clarify boundaries and outputs task board files (.antigravity/tasks/*.md) for OpenCode execution.

sub_modules_zh: agent-skills: 生產級代碼品質評估、重構與輔助除錯工具集
grill-with-docs: 領域模型詰問與架構意圖對齊程序 (關鍵字: 「計劃」、「設計」、「架構」、「grill me」)
Antigravity × OpenCode 協同模式: CLI 直連、Task Board 檔案看板、JSON Hooks 攔截、open-code-review 門禁
team-mode: 依任務難度調度 Pro (高難度架構) 與 Flash (檔案檢索) 模型子 Agent
sub_modules_en: agent-skills: Production-grade code quality evaluation, refactoring, and debugging suite
grill-with-docs: Domain modeling interview and architectural alignment protocol (Triggers: 'plan', 'design', 'architecture')
Antigravity × OpenCode Synergy: Direct CLI, Task Board markdown, JSON Hooks, and open-code-review gate
